plan.title: refactor: retire the coverageDebt/checkResume ritual; keep two plain settings

narratives.Description: session:start quizzes coverageDebt and checkResume but no ship gate reads the answer. This story retires the consent ritual and keeps two plain optional settings with a standing non-default disclosure. It does not wire task check or task release to those flags.

narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Five items: delete ritual/verbs, keep settings+doctor invalid+disclosure, strip inert fields, docs/pack reserved, tests+negative diff.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`session:start` asks the operator to decide `plan.policy.coverageDebt` + `plan.policy.checkResume` (Strict / Hatch-aware / Later). No gate honors the answer. `task check` and `task release` never read the flag. After the operator decides, the surface goes silent — fresh agents cannot see what the project chose.

This is a false contract: the quiz implies a ship bar that does not exist.

The fix is **not** to make the quiz honest. It is to **retire the ritual and keep two plain settings**. Most of the ~1,840-line surface shipped in #3189 is structurally incapable of carrying meaning (see § Inert by construction), and the one feature actually worth having behind it — local suite-stamp resume — does not need a consent quiz at all.

Expected outcome: a strongly negative diff, ~1,840 lines down to under ~200 including tests.

## Evidence (verified against `master` @ 9415977b)

| Claim | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Helpers have no production caller | `isCoverageDebtHatchAllowed` (`policy/coverage-debt.ts:159`), `isLocalStampResumeAllowed` (`policy/check-resume.ts:166`) — referenced only from their own `*.test.ts` |
| `task check` ignores the flag | Zero matches for `coverageDebt`/`checkResume` under `packages/core/src/check/` |
| `task release` ignores the flag | `release/auto-hatch.ts` + `release/pipeline.ts:255-372` implement #3187 without importing `policy/coverage-debt` |
| Only consent-surface code reads it | Production callers: `doctor/checks.ts:1350`, `packages/cli/src/policy.ts`, `policy/coverage-check-resume-presets.ts`. Nothing that gates a ship |
| Decided policy goes silent | `session-start.ts:795` (re-arm) and `:1500` (cold) return `""` unless undecided — unlike the `branch_policy` disclosure at `:783` |
| Docs oversell | `content/docs/consumer-check-contract.md:78-79` lists stamp resume and hatch as available when set |
| Deferred wave has no issue | #3189 amendment wave 4 ("stamp generalized behind `checkResume`") was never filed; `gh issue list` across `coverageDebt\|checkResume\|localStamp` returns only this issue |
| Maintainers feel it | This repo's `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` has `plan.policy = {}` — the nag is live here |

## Cost

| File | Lines |
|---|---|
| `policy/coverage-debt.ts` | 350 |
| `policy/check-resume.ts` | 345 |
| `policy/coverage-check-resume-presets.ts` | 300 |
| `session/coverage-check-resume-nudge.ts` | 82 |
| Tests (3 files) | 565 |
| Doctor check + CLI verbs + `plan-hooks` validators + docs | ~200 |
| **Total** | **~1,840** |

Plus ~1,150 chars / ~290 tokens / 14 printed lines on **every** interactive mutation session-start on any undecided tree. Enforced behavior: none.

## Inert by construction

Not "unused pending a later wave" — these cannot carry meaning:

- **`status: unset|decided` is a behavioral no-op.** `coverage-debt.ts:121` and `:132` force `effectiveMode = status === "decided" ? mode : "off"`, so `{status: unset}` and `{status: decided, mode: off}` resolve identically. The field exists *only* to decide whether the nag fires. Retire the nag and it has no remaining job.
- **`dismissReason` exists only to silence the nag.** Same fate.
- **`ciTrustsLocalStamp` can only hold one value.** Typed literal `false` (`check-resume.ts:43`), validated to reject anything else (`:97-99`), forced constant at `:62`, `:140`, `:197`, `:203`, `:291`. Eleven touch points for a field that is `false`.
- **`coverageDebtLedgerRepoIsSelfOnly()` returns literal `true`** (`coverage-debt.ts:172`) — a constant function standing in for a non-goal guard.
- **`writeCoverageDebt` is ~100 lines** of lock + read-modify-write + audit-log append (`:251-349`), mirrored in `check-resume.ts`, for a value nothing reads.

## Why it stalled: the bundle

`checkResume.localStamp` and `coverageDebt.mode` were bundled into one operator decision to keep the quiz to a single question. Their risk profiles are nothing alike:

- **`localStamp`** — skip re-running a suite already green at the same SHA. Real wall-clock and token savings, the thing consumers feel daily. Safe by construction: SHA-keyed, local-only, CI ignores it. Mechanism already exists at `release/suite-stamp.ts`.
- **`coverageDebt.mode=hatch`** — automates a soft-pass on a consumer repo, and adds *automation*, not *capability*: consumers already have a working manual hatch via `--allow-coverage-debt=#N` (`vitest.config.ts:30`, enforced in `vitest-runner/coverage-debt-teardown.ts`, ledger #2866).

The tell is in #3189's own expansion matrix: fast-before-slow gate ordering was marked "Yes even before nudge" and shipped to consumers with no gate at all (`check/gate-lists.ts:44`). `localStamp` is defensible on identical grounds. Bundling made the safe DX feature inherit the consent burden of the risky one, so neither shipped.

Root cause worth recording as a lesson: **a consent surface was built before the capability it gates.** #3189's principle is right — release-born features must not silently expand to consumers — but consent should ride with the feature, not precede it by three issues.

## Required

### Delete

1. `session/coverage-check-resume-nudge.ts` and both `session-start.ts` call sites (`:795` re-arm, `:1500` cold).
2. `policy/coverage-check-resume-presets.ts` in full — Strict / Hatch-aware / Later / dismiss-with-reason.
3. CLI verbs `policy:coverage-check-resume-preset|later|dismiss` (`packages/cli/src/policy.ts:647-705`).
4. The `undecided` branch of `checkCoverageCheckResumePolicy` (`doctor/checks.ts:1349`; registered at `:1482` and `:1504`). Left in place, doctor reproduces the same false ask one surface over.
5. `status`, `dismissReason`, `ciTrustsLocalStamp`, and `coverageDebtLedgerRepoIsSelfOnly()` from both policy modules, plus the write/audit paths that exist only to set them.

### Keep

6. `coverageDebt.mode: off|warn|hatch` and `checkResume.localStamp: off|on` as plain optional fields, default off, still fail-closed when absent or invalid.
7. `policy:show --field=…` rows and the `plan-hooks` validators.
8. The **invalid-block** branch of the doctor check — a malformed typed block is a real defect worth reporting.
9. **Standing disclosure.** One line on every interactive mutation ritual when either field is non-default (`coverageDebt=hatch localStamp=on`), same class as the `branch_policy` disclosure. Decided must not mean invisible. ~15 tokens; deliberate trade for auditability.

### Docs

10. `content/docs/consumer-check-contract.md:61` and `:78-79` — drop unset-vs-decided and the nag; mark hatch/stamp **reserved**, not available.
11. `content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md:147` and its generated mirror `content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json` — currently "blocked on `plan.policy.coverageDebt`; refuse when unset or off." Literally true, but implies the decided case works. Add a "reserved; consumer expansion not implemented" qualifier and regenerate the pack so the freshness gate stays green. `docs/RELEASING.md:85` carries the same implication.
12. Any copy claiming `task check` is fail-closed must say fail-closed **by policy** — the explicit `--allow-coverage-debt=#N` ledger path (#2866) is a live hatch this flag does not control, and release hatch on this repo is #3187.

## Acceptance

- [ ] No interactive session-start ritual asks Strict / Hatch-aware / Later; the nudge module and both call sites are gone
- [ ] `policy:coverage-check-resume-preset|later|dismiss` are removed; no verb writes `status` or `dismissReason`
- [ ] Doctor no longer reports `undecided`; the invalid-typed-block branch still reports
- [ ] `coverageDebt.mode` and `checkResume.localStamp` resolve fail-closed when absent, invalid, or set to off
- [ ] When either field is non-default, every interactive mutation ritual prints a one-line disclosure (not only `policy:show`)
- [ ] `ciTrustsLocalStamp`, `status`, `dismissReason`, and `coverageDebtLedgerRepoIsSelfOnly()` no longer exist
- [ ] Docs and the release skill describe hatch / local stamp as **reserved**, and name `--allow-coverage-debt=#N` (#2866) as the live manual hatch; skills pack regenerated
- [ ] Unit tests cover fail-closed resolution (absent / invalid / valid), disclosure firing only when non-default, and no remaining nag path
- [ ] Net diff is negative

## Non-goals

- Wiring `task check` or `task release` to the flag in this issue. Any diff touching `packages/core/src/check/` or `packages/core/src/release/` is out of scope — the same fence #3189 set for itself (*"Do not edit `release/*` or `check/orchestrator`"*)
- Removing the `--allow-coverage-debt=#N` manual hatch or its #2866 ledger rules
- Changing framework `task release` Step 5 hatch (#3187)
- CI trust of a laptop suite stamp
- USER.md as the ship bar

## Sequencing

1. **This issue** — retire the ritual, keep two settings, add the disclosure line. Deletes code.
2. **Next** — wire `checkResume.localStamp` into `task check` on its own merits: small, testable, CI-safe, and the actual product win. It needs no quiz; the setting is its own opt-in. Generalizes `release/suite-stamp.ts` (#3188).
3. **Not scheduled** — consumer auto-hatch. `--allow-coverage-debt=#N` already covers the need explicitly. Build it when someone asks, and let it carry its own consent.

## Related

- Residual of #3189 (consent surface only; check/release left unwired)
- Release hatch: #3187, ledger #2866
- Fast-before-slow / release suite stamp: #3188
- Docs: `content/docs/consumer-check-contract.md` § Coverage-debt hatch and local check resume

items.title: Keep settings, invalid doctor, standing disclosure

narrative.Acceptance: Given coverageDebt.mode and checkResume.localStamp, when absent, invalid, or off they resolve fail-closed; doctor reports malformed typed blocks and does not report undecided; interactive mutation ritual prints one disclosure line only when either field is non-default.

Given consumer-check-contract.md, RELEASING.md, and the release skill (pack source + packs:render), hatch/local stamp are described as reserved and --allow-coverage-debt=#N (#2866) is named as the live manual hatch. Pack edit waits until sibling #3315 is off skills-pack-0.1.json.

Given unit tests, fail-closed resolution (absent/invalid/valid), disclosure only when non-default, and no remaining nag path pass; net diff is negative; CHANGELOG cites #3314; check/ and release/ trees are untouched.
